svg.title: Hierarchy of visual areas drawn as boxes. From the retina, a gray parvo channel and a black magno channel run up through the LGN, V1, V2 and V3. Gray arrows lead from V2 and V3 to V4, then to IT and other ventral areas (pictured as a teapot); a black arrow leads from V1 to MT, then to MST and other dorsal areas (pictured as moving objects). V3 also sends a gray arrow to MT, and V4 and MT are joined by a two-way arrow.
